blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Population and Development (CPD) and its partners on Thursday called for wider access to family planning and contraception as the Philippines records its lowest fertility rate yet, while many women still face difficulty obtaining the reproductive health services and methods they need. The call came as the country observes World Contraception Day on Sept. 26 under the theme, “No barriers, just choices: Access to options, freedom to decide.” The observance brought together the CPD, Bayer Philippines Inc., the Philippine Society for Responsible Parenthood Inc.
